9/ 10.11.2023 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned A.P.P. appearing for the State.
Petitioner is an accused for allegedly committing an offence punishable under Section 376 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 4 of the Prevention of Children from Sexual Offences Act, in connection with Palkot Police Station Case No.25 of 2018 (G.R. No.469 of 2018) corresponding to Special POCSO Case No.35 of 2018, pending in the Court of the Exclusive Special Judge (POCSO)-cum-Additional Sessions Judge IV, Gumla.
On the last occasion, learned counsel appearing for the State was directed to inform this Court as to by what time prosecution witness can be examined.
opennyai_summary.decision:
Considering the stage of trial, I am not inclined to grant privilege of bail to the petitioner.
Accordingly, prayer for bail of the petitioner in connection with Palkot Police Station Case No.25 of 2018 (G.R. No.469 of 2018) corresponding to Special POCSO Case No.35 of 2018, pending in the Court of the Exclusive Special Judge (POCSO)-cum-Additional Sessions Judge IV, Gumla, is hereby rejected.
Prosecution is directed to produce the doctor before the Trial Court for his cross examination on the next date fixed, i.e., on 5th December, 2023.
Accused will ensure cross-examination of the doctor.
1 Trial Court will, thereafter, proceed and conclude the trial at the earliest, preferably within three months.
This bail application stands dismissed.
